Electric vehicle charging infrastructure statistics: data tables (EVCI)

Data about electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

From:
Department for Transport
Published:
26 February 2026
Last updated:
27 August 2026 — See all updates

Contents

  1. Public EV charger statistics
  2. Grant schemes for electric vehicle charging statistics
  3. Historic tables

Public EV charger statistics

The latest monthly public EV chargers by country and region tables can be found on the developing faster indicators of transport activity page. These tables include the same summaries as the quarterly EVCI0101 tables and are updated more frequently.

Public EV chargers by geography (EVCI01)

EVCI0101: Public EV chargers by country and region: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 26.9 KB)

EVCI0102: Public EV chargers by local authority: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 199 KB)

EVCI0103: Public EV chargers by parliamentary constituency: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 135 KB)

EVCI0104: Public EV chargers by rural urban classification: England and Wales, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 7.58 KB)

EVCI0105: Public EV chargers by combined authority: England, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 13.9 KB)

EVCI0106: Public EV chargers by county council: England, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 16 KB)

Public EV chargers by charging power band (EVCI02)

EVCI0201: Public EV chargers by power band: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 7.44 KB)

Public EV chargers by journey type and charging need (EVCI03)

EVCI0301: Public EV chargers by location category: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 10.3 KB)

EVCI0302: Public EV chargers by location classification: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 7.8 KB)

Public EV chargers and electric vehicles (EVCI04)

EVCI0401: Plug in and battery electric vehicles per EV charger: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 10.3 KB)

Previously published EV charging devices statistics continue to be updated quarterly and can be found in the historic tables section of this data tables page.

Grant schemes for electric vehicle charging statistics

Grant schemes for public charging (EVCI50)

EVCI5001: On-Street Residential Chargepoint Scheme statistics: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 33.1 KB)

EVCI5002: EVCI5002: Local Electric Vehicle Infrastructure (LEVI) Fund statistics: England, 1 April 2026 (ODS, 9.42 KB)

The period of coverage of LEVI statistics is currently 3 months behind other published electric vehicle charging infrastructure statistics due to the timeliness of the source data. Provisional estimates for the latest period are also provided for consistency of coverage but are subject to revision in future statistical releases.

Grant schemes for home charging (EVCI51)

EVCI5101: Electric vehicle chargepoint grant for renters and flat owners statistics: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 26 KB)

EVCI5102: Electric vehicle chargepoint grant for households with on-street parking statistics: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 6.86 KB)

EVCI5103: Electric vehicle chargepoint grant for residential landlords statistics: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 10.7 KB)

EVCI5104: Electric vehicle infrastructure grant for residential landlords statistics: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 12.1 KB)

Grant schemes for workplace charging (EVCI52)

EVCI5201: Workplace Charging Scheme statistics: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 28.1 KB)

EVCI5202: Workplace Charging Scheme for state-funded education institutions statistics: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 7.76 KB)

EVCI5203: Electric vehicle infrastructure grant for staff and fleets statistics: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 12 KB)

EVCI5204: Electric vehicle chargepoint grant for commercial landlords statistics: United Kingdom, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 10.5 KB)

Other grant schemes (EVCI53)

EVCI5301: NHS Chargepoint Accelerator Scheme statistics: England, 1 July 2026 (ODS, 7.06 KB)
